title: Multimodal Grounding for Household Robots
abstract: We study grounding language and vision for manipulation under occlusion using contrastive pretraining and affordance maps.

title: Neural Theorem Proving with Verifiable Chains
abstract: We propose a hybrid neuro-symbolic prover with verifiable intermediate steps to reduce hallucination in mathematical reasoning.

title: Protein Structure Design with Diffusion Models
abstract: We explore denoising diffusion probabilistic models for protein folding and design, showing improved generalization over autoregressive baselines.

title: Graph Neural Networks for Social Influence Prediction
abstract: This work leverages GNNs to model information propagation in online social networks, predicting influence cascades and interventions.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Chip Floorplanning
abstract: We design an RL-based agent to generate efficient chip layouts, optimizing power, area, and timing, outperforming classical heuristics.

title: Climate Modeling with Transformers
abstract: We apply attention-based sequence models to predict long-term climate patterns, showing improvements in spatiotemporal consistency.

title: Brain-Computer Interfaces via Contrastive Decoding
abstract: This paper introduces a method to decode motor imagery EEG into natural language commands using multimodal contrastive learning.

title: Large Language Models for Legal Reasoning
abstract: We evaluate the ability of LLMs to perform statutory reasoning and precedent retrieval, highlighting gaps in robustness and fairness.

title: Generative Design of Novel Materials
abstract: We introduce a diffusion-based generator for crystalline structures with target thermal and electronic properties.

title: Human-AI Collaboration in Creative Writing
abstract: We investigate co-writing systems where human authors and LLMs iteratively draft and critique, measuring diversity and coherence.
